text: The curd is gathered in a knotted square cloth and pressed, which gives the cushion-shaped square with a 'mamella' crease on top. Rubbing the rind with butter, olive oil or oil and paprika stops it drying out too fast and gives its orange-brown colour, while long ripening makes it sharper.

steps.note: The curd is tied in a square cotton cloth, for cheeses of 0.6–4 kg.

steps.name: rub
steps.note: The rind is coated with butter, olive oil, or oil with paprika, and turns yellow to brownish.
The cheese is turned as it ages: under 150 days it is semi-cured Mahón, over 150 days it is cured, and an artisan one ages at least 60 days.
